metadata.name: responsive-overlay-resize-stability
metadata.description: Keeps one populated ResponsiveDialog mounted, focused, scrolled, bounded, and free of stale drag transforms while the real browser viewport crosses the responsive breakpoint and repeatedly changes orientation.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const input=document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Pane name"]'); const content=document.querySelector('.rcl-responsive-dialog__content'); window.__basInput=input; content.scrollTop=80; input.focus(); return {scrollTop:content.scrollTop}; })()

(() => { const p=document.querySelector('[data-testid="overlays.responsive-dialog"]'); const input=document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Pane name"]'); const c=document.querySelector('.rcl-responsive-dialog__content'); const root=document.querySelector('[data-rcl-responsive-dialog]'); const r=p?.getBoundingClientRect(); const ok=!!p&&root?.dataset.state==='open'&&root?.dataset.presentation==='sheet'&&input?.value==='State survives every resize'&&document.activeElement===input&&c.scrollTop===80&&p.style.transform===''&&r.top>=0&&r.bottom<=innerHeight+1; document.body.dataset.overlayMobileOk=ok?'yes':'no'; return {ok}; })()

evaluate.expression: (() => { const p=document.querySelector('[data-testid="overlays.responsive-dialog"]'); const input=document.querySelector('input[aria-label="Pane name"]'); const c=document.querySelector('.rcl-responsive-dialog__content'); const root=document.querySelector('[data-rcl-responsive-dialog]'); const r=p?.getBoundingClientRect(); const facts={present:!!p,sameNode:window.__basInput===input,state:root?.dataset.state,presentation:root?.dataset.presentation,value:input?.value,focused:document.activeElement===input,scrollTop:c?.scrollTop,transform:p?.style.transform,top:r?.top,bottom:r?.bottom,innerHeight}; const ok=facts.present&&facts.sameNode&&facts.state==='open'&&facts.presentation==='sheet'&&facts.value==='State survives every resize'&&facts.focused&&facts.scrollTop===80&&facts.transform===''&&facts.top>=0&&facts.bottom<=facts.innerHeight+1; document.body.dataset.overlayFinalOk=ok?'yes':'no'; return {ok,facts}; })()
